article.title: 更進新聞：Bing AI Overviews廣告沿用現有活動
article.title_en: Update: Bing AI Overview ads use existing campaigns
article.summary: Microsoft宣布Bing AI Overviews可在答案旁顯示相關廣告，讓既有活動進入新的AI搜尋版位。
article.summary_en: Microsoft announced ads beside Bing AI Overview answers, extending existing campaigns into an AI search placement.
highlights: 毋須另建獨立活動，支援現有活動包括Performance Max及AI Max。
原文列明在中國以外市場提供，並非保證每次查詢都有廣告。
highlights_en: No separate campaign setup is required; existing routes include Performance Max and AI Max.
The stated scope covers markets outside China, without guaranteeing an ad on every query.
article.why: 搜尋需求可在AI整理的答案旁銜接商業訊息，媒體團隊可重新檢視現有素材是否能回應較完整的情境。
article.why_en: Media teams can assess whether existing creative addresses the fuller situations described in AI answers.
article.next_step: 選一組旅遊住宿查詢，把AI答案可能涵蓋的行程需求與現有酒店廣告逐項對照，再確認可取得的投放報表。
article.next_step_en: Compare a travel-itinerary context with current hotel ads and confirm the reporting available for delivery.
article.detail: Microsoft以國家公園行程旁出現酒店廣告說明機制，廣告仍由既有活動承接。團隊可先列出產品在同一情境中的不同需求，核對素材和落地頁是否提供相應資訊，再向平台確認能觀察哪些版位及表現資料。這是廣告庫存與呈現方式的改變，不能由公告推定新增版位已改善銷售。
article.detail_en: Microsoft illustrates hotel ads beside a national-park itinerary. Map the different needs in one product context to creative and destination information, then confirm observable placement data with the platform. An inventory change does not establish improved sales.
article.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技
article.followup: 11月21日版報道AI素材聲明；同一11月19日公告亦涵蓋Bing答案廣告。本篇補充較早的版位消息，早於前述期數。
article.followup_en: Our November 21 issue covered AI creative declarations. The same November 19 announcement also covered Bing answer ads; this adds earlier placement information published before that issue.
